name: Toast Mobile Menu – Fast & Lightweight Responsive Navigation
author: Toast Plugins

sections.description:
Toast Mobile Menu helps you instantly improve mobile navigation, reduce UI clutter, and maintain fast page load speeds — without bloated features or complex setup.

Built for performance and simplicity, it’s perfect for developers, agencies, and site owners who want a mobile menu that just works.

🚀 Why Toast Mobile Menu?

Most mobile menu plugins are feature-heavy, complex, or performance-heavy.

Toast Mobile Menu focuses on simplicity, speed, and usability.

⚡ Faster Mobile Performance – no unnecessary scripts or bloat
📱 Better Mobile UX – smoother navigation increases engagement
🚀 Instant Setup – works in minutes, not hours
🧩 Theme Compatible – works with most WordPress themes out of the box
🎯 Conversion-Friendly Navigation – helps users find content faster

❌ The Problem with Most Mobile Menu Plugins

  • Too many unnecessary features
  • Slower page performance
  • Overcomplicated setup
  • Poor mobile UX and cluttered navigation

✅ The Toast Solution

  • Lightweight, performance-first design
  • Clean, distraction-free mobile menus
  • Works instantly with most themes
  • Built for speed-focused WordPress sites

✨ Features

  • Modern hamburger mobile menu designs
  • Smooth open/close animations
  • Submenu support
  • Fully responsive design
  • Lightweight performance-focused code
  • Works with most WordPress themes
  • Customisable and next-gen AJAX search
  • No page builder required
  • Icon and menu item support
  • Developer-friendly structure

👥 Perfect For:

  • WordPress developers building performance-focused sites
  • Agencies managing client websites
  • Bloggers who care about mobile UX
  • WooCommerce store owners
  • Anyone optimizing for Core Web Vitals

👉 Lightweight. Fast. No bloat. Just works.
sections.installation:
Install from WordPress Admin

  1. Go to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Toast Mobile Menu”
  4. Click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP file
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate Plugin”

After Activation

  1. Go to the Toast Mobile Menu settings panel
  2. Configure your menu settings (if required)
  3. Choose your menu screen width breakpoint
  4. Save changes and test on mobile devices
sections.faq:
How is Toast Mobile Menu different from other mobile menu plugins?

Most mobile menu plugins are feature-heavy and can feel bloated or complex.

Toast Mobile Menu focuses on simplicity and performance, providing a fast, lightweight mobile navigation experience without unnecessary features or setup.

Does this plugin only affect mobile devices?

By default, Toast Mobile Menu is designed for mobile devices.

However, you can set the screen width at which it activates, allowing it to be used on tablets or desktop if needed.

Does it support dropdowns or submenus?

Yes. Toast Mobile Menu supports dropdown menus and nested submenus for more complex navigation structures.
